0.1.2.en: First release: control Nice Yubii Home / Fibaro HC3 shutters locally (open, close, stop, travel time, command repeat).

0.2.1.en: More device types (beta): Nice gates/garage doors, lights/dimmers, switches/plugs with power, sensors. Automatic hub discovery. Live state updates via the hub change feed.

0.2.2.en: Fixes: changing the connection on one device now updates all devices of that hub; no missed changes at startup; clearer error messages.
